# SelectionRangeSlider { #anylumino.SelectionRangeSlider }

```python
SelectionRangeSlider(
    options=(),
    value=None,
    index=None,
    description='',
    disabled=False,
    orientation='horizontal',
    readout=True,
    **kwargs,
)
```

Range slider selection control.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name        | Type     | Description                                    | Default        |
|-------------|----------|------------------------------------------------|----------------|
| options     | optional | Selectable values or ``(label, value)`` pairs. | `()`           |
| value       | optional | Initial value and synced Python value.         | `None`         |
| index       | optional | Selected option index.                         | `None`         |
| description | optional | Label shown above the control.                 | `''`           |
| disabled    | optional | Whether user interaction is disabled.          | `False`        |
| orientation | optional | ``'horizontal'`` or ``'vertical'``.            | `'horizontal'` |
| readout     | optional | Whether to show the current value.             | `True`         |

## Attributes

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [control_kind](#anylumino.SelectionRangeSlider.control_kind) | A trait for unicode strings. |
